about_the_game:
Farmare is a survival roguelite RPG with base-building mechanics.

Survive relentless waves of enemies in fast-paced roguelite action. Build and expand your base between runs to unlock new upgrades, permanent bonuses, and powerful abilities. Grow stronger with every attempt and push your limits further each night.

Features

⚔️ Wave Survival Combat
Every run challenges you with waves of enemies that grow stronger and more unpredictable the longer you survive. Battles start small, but quickly escalate into chaotic swarms where positioning, movement, and upgrades make the difference between victory and defeat.

💰 Dynamic Upgrade System
Collect coins during combat and spend them immediately to empower your character for that run. Boost your attack speed, strengthen your defenses, unlock special abilities, or experiment with different combinations each time. No two runs ever feel the same.

🏡 Base Building Progression
Between battles, return to your farmstead and expand it with new structures. Each building unlocks permanent bonuses, weapons, and upgrades that carry over into future runs. Building your base is more than cosmetic — it’s the backbone of your long-term survival.

🔄 Roguelite Replayability
Every run is unique. Experiment with different upgrade paths, discover new synergies, and find strategies that suit your playstyle. Failure is never the end — every defeat teaches you something and earns you resources to improve for the next attempt.

⚡ Skill-Based Movement
Dodging isn’t optional — it’s survival. Master the dash and dodge mechanics to slip through deadly swarms, outmaneuver powerful attacks, and carve out breathing room when things get overwhelming. Smart movement is just as important as raw firepower.

🌌 Endless Progression
With every run, your character and base grow stronger. Push further, unlock new tools, and discover how far you can go. Whether you’re chasing high scores, perfecting strategies, or just surviving as long as possible, Farmare keeps the challenge fresh.

Story

One quiet night, a hardworking farmer drifts off to sleep, expecting nothing more than another peaceful evening. But suddenly, he wakes with a start — “What’s happening?!” — as a chicken bursts at him out of nowhere! Armed with nothing but his trusty farm tools, he must fight for survival, wave after wave of relentless enemies testing his skills.

Each encounter is a chance to grow stronger. Collect coins during combat to gain temporary boosts, then return to your farmstead to build new structures, unlock permanent upgrades, and prepare for the next night. With every run, the farm evolves, your weapons improve, and your strategy becomes sharper.

The question isn’t just if you can survive the night… it’s how far you can push yourself, how smartly you build, and how cleverly you fight. Every dawn brings new challenges — and new opportunities to master your farm, your tools, and your skills.
